guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance & Outlook
section: Kinetik now expects its 2026 Adjusted EBITDA1 to be at the high end of its $1.04 billion to $1.1 billion guidance range, reflecting (i) gas gathering and processing fee benefiting from stronger-than-expected well results; (ii) robust operating performance that has yielded stronger-than-expected equity volumes; and (iii) commodity prices outperforming the Company’s guidance assumptions set forth in August 2026.

Kinetik anticipates 2026 Capital Expenditures2 (including maintenance) to be approximately 5% below its August 2026 guidance of $560 million. The capital reduction is largely driven by disciplined execution of the Company’s growth capital program and timing of project spend.
